title: Statistics on Beds for Homeless within Shelters and Measures to Support Transition into Long-term Residences
what_it_is: Statistics on Beds for Homeless within Shelters and Measures to Support Transition into Long-term Residences

sections.label: Transitional Shelter bed spaces
sections.summary: There are 730 and 160 total bed spaces, and Transitional Shelters provide onsite social work intervention to residents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The total bed spaces are 730 and 160 respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Transitional Shelters provide onsite social work intervention to residents to help them address underlying issues and work towards stable long-term accommodation options.

sections.label: Average Transitional Shelter stay
sections.summary: Recent data shows youths and young adults stayed an average of seven months in Transitional Shelters, versus 10 months for individuals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Based on data in recent years, the average length of stay for youths and young adults in Transitional Shelters was seven months, compared to 10 months for individuals in Transitional Shelters.

sections.label: SSO officers on night walks
sections.summary: SSO officers accompany PEERS Network community partners weekly whenever they conduct night walks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: On the first question, our Social Service Office (SSO) officers do accompany our Partners Engaging and Empowering Rough Sleepers (PEERS) Network community partners on a weekly basis, whenever they conduct the night walks.

sections.label: Surge capacity with community partners
sections.summary: Working closely with community partners to ensure sufficient surge capacity is a practice kept from pandemic days.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: With regards to capacity and utilisation rates, it is a good practice that we have kept from pandemic days, where we work very closely with our community partners to make sure that there is sufficient surge capacity, should there be a need to exercise them.

sections.label: Rough sleeper street counts
sections.summary: In 2022, about 16 of 530 rough sleepers were on the streets, rising to about 30 of 496 in 2025, from 3% to 6%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: If you compare numbers, in 2022, where we did our last street count of the 530 rough sleepers that we have observed then, there were about 16 rough sleepers on the streets.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Last year, where we did our nationwide street count again in 2025, of the 496 rough sleepers, we had about 30.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: This represented an increase, in terms of percentage, from 3% then in 2022, to 6%.
